specs.Compatible Devices: Gaming Console, Laptop, Smartphone, Speaker, Tablet

features: Official Google TV Integration: Wzatco Yuva Infinity projector features official Google TV with WideVine L1 certification for high resolution streaming across Netflix, Prime Video, Zee5, SonyLIV, and Hotstar. Includes Google Cast for seamless mirroring and Google Assistant voice control via Bluetooth mouse for smart entertainment access

1200 ANSI Brightness with Sealed Engine and Native 1080P: Delivers cinema-grade visuals with 1200 ANSI brightness and Advanced Sealed Optical Engine for long-lasting clarity. Features native 1080P resolution and 99% color gamut for rich, lifelike visuals with reduced blue light and enhanced dark-scene detail for comfortable viewing in brighter rooms

Fully Automatic Setup with Intelligent Sensor and 100%-50% Zoom: Features intelligent Auto Focus for instant sharpness, Auto Keystone for alignment, Obstacle Avoidance that detects and adjusts around interruptions, and Screen Fit that automatically adjusts to projector screen confines for a seamless, hands-free experience with optimized frames

Advanced Rotatable Design with Built-in Stand: Premium rotatable body and built-in stand allow smooth angle adjustments for flexible projection positioning. Smart design enables effortless setup in any location

Short Throw Ratio 1:1 for Large Display: Short throw ratio of 1.1 delivers an immersive display of up to 300 inches from a remarkably short distance, providing maximum flexibility and clutter-free setup in any room without complicated placement requirements

Warranty Information: Nationwide warranty coverage with 1-Year warranty from the date of purchase provided by Wzatco India. Product registration is mandatory to avail warranty benefits. Visit the company's website for additional details

4K Ultra HD Support with WiFi 6 and Bluetooth 5.1: Supports 4K Ultra HD content with smooth playback, equipped with WiFi 6 for fast wireless connectivity and Bluetooth 5.1 for seamless audio pairing with external speakers and devices
Multiple Connectivity Options: Includes ARC, HDMI, and USB ports for versatile connection to gaming consoles, streaming devices, laptops, and external storage for flexible entertainment options
